port.description: UDP/TCP port the server listens on. Must match client port settings.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server simultaneously.

hostname.description: Public name of the server displayed in the server browser.

server_message.description: Short welcome message shown to players on connect and in browser.

initial_map.description: First map loaded when the server starts. Must be a valid Quake map name (e.g., 'start', 'e1m1').

game_type.description: Game variant: 0 = Quake (SP), 1 = QuakeWorld (netplay), 2 = Quake II (unsupported).

dedicated.description: Run as a headless server (recommended for production). Disable only for local testing.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, empty = all interfaces).

join_password.description: Password players must enter to join the server. Leave empty for public access.

admin_password.description: Password to authenticate as server admin via console (e.g., 'setmaster' or 'rcon').

enable_spectators.description: Allow players to join as spectators (non-participating viewers).

log_file.description: Path to server log file. Empty string disables logging.

auto_save_interval.description: Interval (in minutes) between automatic map saves. Set to 0 to disable.

announce_to_master.description: Whether to register the server with the public Quake master server list.

master_address.description: Master server address used for public listing. Default is id's legacy master.

cvars.description: Custom Quake CVARs to override defaults (e.g., 'sv_maxvelocity', 'g_select_empty').

mod_search_path.description: List of directories to search for mods/maps (colon-separated in config).

startup_commands.description: Commands to execute after map load (semicolon-separated in config).
